notes.subject: אשר
notes.rationale: Rel particle has no Kyrgyz equivalent; the clause link is carried by 'анткени' and punctuation.

notes.subject: מעברים
notes.rationale: Hiphil participle of עבר 'to cross over': 'causing-to-transgress' (KJV 'ye make...transgress') vs JPS 'do spread abroad' — rendered as 'мыйзамдан чыгаруучулар' to keep the crossing-over picture.

notes.subject: ⟨бул⟩
notes.rationale: Kyrgyz needs a demonstrative to link the report to its content; Hebrew leaves the participle phrase appositional.

notes.subject: to Hophni and Phinehas
notes.rationale: Eli directly addresses his sons: 'жок, балдарым'.

translation: Жок, балдарым, анткени мен уккан кабар жакшы эмес — ⟨бул⟩ Яхвенин элин мыйзамдан чыгаруучулар жөнүндө.
